opening.argument: The presentation promotes spot-futures arbitrage bots as a low-risk, consistent source of passive income and directs viewers to create one through a description link. It explains allocating capital to buy cryptocurrency in the spot market while shorting the same amount in futures, then instructs viewers to click Create and activate the bot. The description supplies a link to create an arbitrage bot, while the platform display shows a 305.7 USDT investment balance and a visible CREATE control. Although it acknowledges that higher leverage increases liquidation risk, it also reports a 41% profit and funding-rate results from September 2020 to September 2021, expressly historical rather than guaranteed future returns. These features establish a trading-bot returns pitch with stated limitations.

citations.quote: Spot futures arbitrage bots, most popularized by Pionex, are a low-risk and consistent way to generate passive income.
SpotFutures arbitrage bot by clicking the first link in the description below.
During the same period, the profit ended up being 41%.
The higher the leverage is, the higher the profit is. But the futures position will be easier to be liquidated.
